trigger_condition: Frequent photos, including local activity, connect months of observations.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Specify episode-boundary evidence and whether local observations participate; adjacent gaps alone cannot define a trip.
potential_consequence: Transitive grouping merges separate trips into one months-long journey.

location: MVP spec / larger gaps create separate candidates
trigger_condition: Tokyo on day 1 and Kyoto on day 6 belong to one continuous holiday.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Retain observed segments with an unresolved relationship; use bounded merge rules or owner merge. Uncertainty alone must not merge.
potential_consequence: Sparse photography fragments trips; unlimited gap tolerance creates the opposite error.

trigger_condition: Midnight, changing or missing offsets, or date-only timestamps make gaps ambiguous.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Define the calendar and comparison semantics; preserve uncertain intervals and avoid invented ordering.
potential_consequence: Assignments vary with device timezone or implementation choices.

location: MVP spec / place clustering; Place/visit draft
trigger_condition: The same hotel is visited in January and June or twice within one journey.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Separate geographic place identity from chronological visit identity; specify episode boundaries.
potential_consequence: Separate visits collapse and chronological sequences are lost.

location: MVP spec / five-kilometre neighborhood and bounded diameter
trigger_condition: A-B and B-C are near, A-C exceeds the bound, and B arrives later.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Specify diameter, distance calculation, tie-break and deterministic ordering; compare full and incremental results.
potential_consequence: Import order changes places and journeys.

trigger_condition: The owner moves, has two homes, or imports history predating the current home.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Give confirmed usual areas effective periods, permitting multiple areas and unknown applicability.
potential_consequence: Current home misclassifies past residence or holidays.

location: MVP spec / previous recommendation: return-home precedence
trigger_condition: A single home-located image is imported, incorrectly tagged or uncertain in time.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Separate an owner-confirmed return from home-proximate metadata; only the explicit owner boundary is binding.
potential_consequence: A false home signal splits a genuine trip.

location: MVP spec / data contract; previous membership categories
trigger_condition: A companion's photo is a legitimate memory, or a downloaded image depicts an unvisited place.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Separate trip association, contribution to location evidence and owner confirmation; no probability implied by category names.
potential_consequence: Trip relevance is confused with proof of presence, or legitimate memories are excluded.

location: MVP spec / missing GPS; previous temporal-bracketing recommendation
trigger_condition: An unlocated photo lies between different trips or has only an ambiguous day timestamp.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Require comparable time, bounded context, one compatible candidate and no conflicting boundary; otherwise retain candidates or leave unassigned.
potential_consequence: Unrelated photos are attached or a location is fabricated.

trigger_condition: Cases with different confirmed boundaries have identical coarse places, offsets and counts.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Derive constraints locally; send only eligible alternatives and permitted structural constraints, then enforce them locally.
potential_consequence: AI cannot recover omitted context and guesses between cases requiring different outcomes.

trigger_condition: Real evidence IDs are combined into an unsupported journey or narrative.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Validate claimed relationships and allowed reason codes, not only existence of IDs; keep narrative reviewable.
potential_consequence: Structurally valid output makes an unsupported grouping or claim.

location: MVP spec / correction overlay; background maintenance
trigger_condition: A corrected target splits, merges or changes identity after new evidence.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Define correction scope over evidence membership and boundaries, identity lineage and conflict handling.
potential_consequence: Corrections disappear or attach to the wrong successor.

location: MVP spec / confirmed journey; background maintenance
trigger_condition: New evidence adds a destination, photo or date extension to a confirmed journey.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Confirmation covers reviewed facts and membership versions; additions remain inferred or pending.
potential_consequence: Unreviewed additions inherit confirmation and affect future sharing previews.

trigger_condition: A bridging photo triggers further transitive candidate merges.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Define dependency expansion and convergence; checkpoint bounded work and keep partial reconciliation visibly pending.
potential_consequence: Incremental and full results differ, or background work becomes unbounded.

trigger_condition: Both opposite split/merge outputs satisfy support and schema checks.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Add expected membership, acceptable ambiguity and prohibited assertions for core cases, including reordered and incremental imports.
potential_consequence: Tests pass without specifying the engine's defining behavior.

trigger_condition: Timestamp precision or missing timezone makes the three-calendar-day comparison ambiguous.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Compare explicit time intervals; indeterminate ordering or gap retains an uncertain boundary.
potential_consequence: Identical evidence receives different assignments depending on timezone assumptions.

trigger_condition: Photos revisit the same geographical place before and after another destination.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Separate reusable place identity from chronological visits; preserve A-B-A episodes.
potential_consequence: Repeated visits collapse, losing sequence or assigning photos to the wrong episode.

trigger_condition: One photo fits multiple nearby clusters whose union exceeds the diameter bound.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Specify diameter, metric and stable tie-break; verify input-order invariance.
potential_consequence: Import order or background additions change place membership and trip boundaries.

trigger_condition: Frequent photos bridge trips through local activity or an intervening return home.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Evaluate episode-boundary evidence before linking; unresolved boundaries remain reviewable.
potential_consequence: A short-gap chain merges unrelated trips into one long journey.

trigger_condition: Gap-uncertainty refinement encounters successive sparse trips without reliable return-home evidence.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Keep bounded candidate episodes and possible-merge relations; uncertainty never authorizes merging alone.
potential_consequence: Open-ended continuity merges months of unrelated travel.

trigger_condition: A traveller changes residence, maintains two usual areas or revisits a former home.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Usual-area assertions carry effective dates, multiple areas and unknown periods.
potential_consequence: Today's home classification rewrites historical travel and residence.

trigger_condition: A near-home airport, transfer or downloaded home photo appears between trip destinations.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Distinguish home-proximate evidence from an owner-confirmed episode end.
potential_consequence: Incidental near-home evidence splits a continuing journey.

trigger_condition: A GPS-less photo fits two journeys or lies between geotagged photos separated by weeks.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Require comparable capture times, bounded context and one compatible candidate; otherwise leave unassigned.
potential_consequence: Temporal bracketing attaches unrelated images or arbitrarily chooses a journey.

trigger_condition: A photo belongs to a journey without a defensible destination assignment.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Represent journey membership separately from visit support, with uncertainty and owner assignment.
potential_consequence: The model fabricates a place or cannot retain a relevant trip photo.

trigger_condition: Shared or downloaded photos contain valid trip-compatible timestamps and GPS.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Separate contextual relevance from presence support; preserve association source uncertainty.
potential_consequence: Relevant memories incorrectly contribute destinations or owner-presence claims.

trigger_condition: Late evidence extends or bridges confirmed and unconfirmed journeys.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Confirmation covers reviewed facts and membership versions; additions remain inferred.
potential_consequence: New evidence inherits confirmation and appears reviewed in future sharing previews.

trigger_condition: Reconstruction splits or merges the target of an earlier correction.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Persist correction scope and lineage; resolve ambiguous remapping before structural changes commit.
potential_consequence: Corrections orphan, disappear or attach to the wrong successor.

trigger_condition: An AI response completes after evidence changes or the owner edits the journey.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Bind proposals to evidence, correction and consent revisions; discard or revalidate stale results.
potential_consequence: Stale proposals restore obsolete evidence or undo newer grouping.

trigger_condition: Opaque IDs and day offsets conceal geographic relationships needed for grouping.
guard_snippet: Recommended: Derive permitted coarse relationship flags locally or withhold grouping when context is absent.
potential_consequence: AI groups without discriminating evidence; schema checks cannot detect arbitrary reasoning.
